To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
WAFEx can be used to find previously unknown, multi stage attacks against web applications.

we propose an approach for the security testing of web applications that (i) is formal, (ii) can be automated, (iii) exploits vulnerabilities of web applications, (iv) combines multiple vulnerabilities for the exploitation of complex, multi-stage attacks and (v) can find previously unknown vulnerabilities.

(i) we propose a formal model for the representation of web applications and attacks, (ii) we propose a novel, model based, approach for the security testing of web applications and we implement it in WAFEx, (iii) WAFEx was used for the security analysis and testing of real world case studies and it found previously unknown attacks, (iv) the proposed model and approach can be used to identify multi stage attacks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new techniques for the security testing of web applications and the development of a tool, WAFEx, that can be used to support security analysts in their task.
the security analysis of complex web applications.
a novel approach to the security analysis of modern web applications that is able to exploit the full potential of the web application security analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the work presented in this thesis has contributed to the field of web application security by providing a formal, model-based testing approach for the automated generation of attacks and by providing an efficient and practical implementation that has been applied to real world case-studies and has been shown to find new attacks.
WAFEx is a new and innovative approach for the automated security analysis of web application that has shown to be effective.
WAFEx has the potential to become a very powerful tool for the penetration testing phase of security analysis of web application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a formal, model-based approach for the security assessment of web applications and a tool that implements this approach and can automatically identify previously unknown, multi stage, attacks of web applications that are difficult, or even impossible, to be identified by existing tools for the security assessment.

WAFEx is the only tool, to my best knowledge, that can exploit the vulnerabilities of web applications in a systematic, automated and efficient manner, thus allowing for a more complete security analysis of web based applications.

we propose an approach and tool that can automatically identify complex, multi stage, vulnerabilities of web applications, and can exploit them to attack a system, and that we show its efficiency by successfully applying it on real world case studies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach can be used to identify attacks that no other tool for security testing of web applications can identify.
, by using formal models and a formal approach to the security analysis of Web applications, we can automate penetration testing, which, in turn, can help us identify new attacks.
, by exploiting the formal definition of the web applications, we can automate the penetration testing phase of security analysis.
